summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, announcing the acquisition of 100% of Internode Pharma Limited and HAP Pharma Limited, UK-based licensed cannabis importer, wholesaler, and pharmacy, for GBP 2.1 million in cash, subject to post-closing conditions. The transaction aims to give Aurora direct control of the UK supply chain, is expected to be accretive to adjusted EBITDA, and supports expansion in the UK medical cannabis market. No advisors or board recommendations were disclosed. Watch for regulatory approvals and integration execution.
